secrets.name: RAZORPAY_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Razorpay API key ID for real India payments (UPI, cards, netbanking). Optional — app runs in demo mode without it. Get from https://dashboard.razorpay.com/app/keys

secrets.name: RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET
secrets.description: Razorpay API key secret for payment signature verification. Optional — app runs in demo mode without it. Get from https://dashboard.razorpay.com/app/keys

secrets.name: MAIL_SERVER
secrets.description: SMTP server hostname for sending emails (password resets, order notifications). Optional — emails are logged instead when empty.

secrets.name: MAIL_USERNAME
secrets.description: SMTP username for email authentication. Optional — only needed if MAIL_SERVER is set.

secrets.name: MAIL_PASSWORD
secrets.description: SMTP password for email authentication. Optional — only needed if MAIL_SERVER is set.
